Name: Fahrschule easy 2009/2010: Sicher durch  die theoretische Prüfung
Overview:
Over 1.3 million student drivers in Germany study for their driver's license exam every year.

This new console software now helps all beginners study for the theoretical driving test with a lot more fun. The highlight is that this doesn't strictly have to be done on a PC, because cramming at a computer can be pretty boring. That’s why study sessions are being moved to the living room or your own bedroom—comfortably on the sofa with your console. The program is very easy to operate via the DVD function using the gamepad and Xbox, displayed large and clear on your TV or screen.

Features:
Driving School Easy 2009/2010 prepares you safely, quickly, successfully, and with more fun for the theoretical driving test! It contains all official questions that can be used in the actual theory exam.

By selecting the Reading, Practice, or Exam mode, you determine your own learning pace and progress.

You can run a real exam simulation at any time and then intensively review the questions you answered incorrectly.

Reading Mode: Practice by reading.

Practice Mode: Answer the questions. Every wrong answer is corrected immediately.

Exam Mode: A random generator selects the exam questions, providing detailed results at the end of the test.

Everything is coordinated so you can immediately see where you are confident and what still needs to be practiced.

Simply insert the DVD into the console and you can learn, answer questions, practice, and test yourself easily and comfortably using the controller. With instant results!
